target.title: fix(line): cap user profile cache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where LINE gateways running for extended periods accumulate an unbounded in-process user profile cache. `userProfileCache` in `extensions/line/src/send.ts` stores resolved display names keyed by LINE user ID, with no eviction path. Every distinct sender the gateway encounters over its lifetime occupies a permanent `Map` entry. On high-volume LINE channels (group chats, broadcast events with many unique senders) this Map grows monotonically until the process restarts.

## Why This Change Was Made

Introduces a `cacheLineUserProfile` helper wrapping every `userProfileCache.set` call. The helper applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` to cap the Map at **1 024 entries** with LRU eviction: the oldest entry is removed first when the Map is at capacity, keeping recently used profiles resident.

A `resetLineUserProfileCacheForTests()` export is added to keep the eviction regression test isolated between runs.

**Diff:** 2 files, +39 / −1 lines

## User Impact

Operators running LINE channels on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for the profile-name cache. Behavior is identical for normal workloads; only the least-recently-used profiles are evicted under high-cardinality traffic.

## Evidence

**New regression test, passing on `fix/line-cap-user-profile-cache`:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-line.config.ts \
    extensions/line/src/send.test.ts \
    --reporter=verbose

 ✓ LINE send helpers > limits quick reply items to 13                                             63ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > truncates quick reply labels without leaving lone surrogates                1ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > pushes images via normalized LINE target                                    1ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > replies when reply token is provided                                        1ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > sends video with explicit image preview URL                                 0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > throws when video preview URL is missing                                    1ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > blocks private-network media URLs before calling LINE                       0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > omits trackingId for non-user destinations                                  0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > throws when push messages are empty                                         0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > rejects lowercased LINE-shaped recipients (#81628 safety net)               0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > accepts case-exact LINE recipients with the leading capital preserved       0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > logs HTTP body when push fails                                              0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > caches profile results by default                                           0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > evicts oldest profile cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap          4ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > continues when loading animation is unsupported                             0ms
 ✓ LINE send helpers > pushes quick-reply text and caps to 13 buttons                              0ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
   Duration  1.10s
```
